messages:

Cc: finance@cloudharbor.com
Date: 2027-05-02T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Final accounting info & VAT evidence needed for closeout

Hi Tessa,

As we approach the contract end date on 2027-05-31, finance needs the final statement and supporting VAT evidence to trigger payment. Can you please send:

- The final invoice for the DH-11984 true-up (with itemized usage and credits)
- Confirmation of tax treatment (we need to confirm whether this will be VAT reverse-charge or if Redwood will invoice with VAT)
- SOC 2 / VAT evidence summary for our auditors (a short PDF is fine)

Our PO # will be provided once we receive the final invoice PDF and bank details. If you can get this to us by EOD 2027-05-04 that will keep our payment calendar on track.

Thanks,
Laura Barnes
Senior Procurement Manager
CloudHarbor Inc.

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear list. We can do all of the above. High-level plan:

1) Karthik will assemble the final itemized invoice and true-up calculation (includes monthly usage, overage credits, and reserved capacity adjustments).
2) Neha will attach the VAT evidence pack (SOC2 summary + tax certificate) and confirm recommended tax treatment for an EU buyer.
3) I will send the final invoice PDF with bank wiring details and include the PO field so you can confirm.

Target: send invoice + evidence by 2027-05-04 EOD as requested. If there are any special fields your AP system needs on the invoice (cost center, GL code, billing address override), please let us know now.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0192

Date: 2027-05-03T08:27:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Final accounting info & VAT evidence needed for closeout

Folks — pulling numbers now. Notes for the invoice:

- Usage true-up: 1,824,300 tokens @ $0.0009 = $1,641.87 (rounded)
- Reserved capacity credit: -$1,000.00 (prorated)
- One-time professional services (migration) credit: -$250.00
- Final invoice subtotal: $391.87

Question for Neha: CloudHarbor is an EU-registered entity (VAT ID received earlier). Do we apply reverse-charge (net invoice) or invoice with UK/EU VAT? My read: reverse-charge applies when CloudHarbor is the recipient and provides a valid VAT ID, but need confirmation and evidence for their AP team.

I'll draft the invoice PDF and include line-level breakdown. Tessa — want me to include our bank wiring and SWIFT on the PDF or send payment details in a separate cover email?

Karthik
Sr. Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: draft-trueup-calc.xlsx (stub)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-03T10:46:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Final accounting info & VAT evidence needed for closeout

Thanks — confirmed.

Summary for AP:
- CloudHarbor provided a valid EU VAT number (format checked). Per our tax guidance, this transaction qualifies for reverse-charge (net invoice) provided the buyer is VAT-registered and uses the services in an EU member state. We will therefore issue a net invoice (no VAT).
- For audit evidence we will include: SOC 2 summary, Business Registration, and a short VAT-treatment memo signed by our tax counsel.

I have prepared the VAT pack (3-page PDF) and the short memo. If CloudHarbor prefers the invoice to show a line stating "VAT: Reverse charge — customer to account for VAT", we can add that to the invoice text.

Also: on the bank details, keep wiring instructions on the invoice PDF but mark them as "For AP use only" to avoid public sharing.

Neha Kapoor
Tax & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Laura — attaching the final materials as requested. Summary below:

- Attachment A: Redwood_Invoice_11984_20270504.pdf (Final invoice, net value $391.87, includes PO field left blank for your PO #; invoice states "VAT: Reverse charge — customer to account for VAT" as requested)
- Attachment B: CloudHarbor_Final_Statement_Q1_2027.pdf (itemized usage and true-up math)
- Attachment C: VAT_Evidence_Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (SOC2 summary + VAT treatment memo)

Banking/Wiring: included on page 2 of the invoice PDF (for AP only). If your AP needs the bank details as a separate bank form, say the word and we can send an AP-specific cover letter.

Please confirm when you upload the invoice to your system and provide the PO # so we can mark this invoice as pending payment. Expected payment terms: 30 days from receipt per contract (net 30).

Thanks for the quick coordination — ping me if anything else is needed.

Best,
